user.title: Connect to Abralife
user.description: Sign in with the same e-mail and password you use in the Abralife app. The password is only used once to get a login token and is never stored in Home Assistant.

api_settings.name: Advanced API settings
api_settings.description: Normally pre-filled. Values are listed on {portal}.

home.title: Choose home
home.description: Your account has several homes. Pick the one to add (you can add the others later).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} has expired. Enter your Abralife password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Abralife. Check the network and the API settings.
error.mfa_not_supported: The account requires two-factor authentication or a password change. Finish that in the Abralife app first.
error.missing_api_settings: Fill in all fields under Advanced API settings.

abort.no_homes: No homes were found on this account.

data.allow_open_valve: Allow opening the water from Home Assistant

data_description.allow_open_valve: Closing is always allowed. Only enable opening if you are sure automations can't reopen the water during an active leak.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Abralife cloud.

open_disabled.message: Opening the water from Home Assistant is disabled in the integration options.
